column1: # The normalization table of the parity harness (ADR-draft-parity-harness-with-variants), read by
# scripts/check-parity.sh. One row per bash message, three fields separated by tabs: an extended
# regular expression the message after "  - " matches, the rule ID of nuc it maps to, and
# "line" when the bash message names a line, "-" when it names none and the comparison leaves the
# line out. A bash message no row matches is a difference, so a ported rule brings its rows, and
# a check that is not ported yet is caught when it fires on a tree of the corpus.
# check-docs.sh, check 14: the template release named.
^README\.md: the Template release line names neither
